title: Concept: poetry.lock in the legacy format
description: poetry.lock declares a lockfile whose `lock-version` is 1.x, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The old format records less provenance per package and is regenerated differently, so the graph the review reads can differ from the one that installs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through poetry.lock (pypi).
risk: The old format records less provenance per package and is regenerated differently, so the graph the review reads can differ from the one that installs.
